title: Both response producers stop writing developer prose
outcome: No error response body carries a free-text field, from either the Node handler or the Edge 401, so there is nothing on the wire for any client to display.
acceptanceCriteria: serializeError writes code, reason and, for ValidationError, details; it no longer writes detail. The unreachable fallback body in the same file is brought to the same shape rather than left as a second definition of what an error response looks like.

proxy.ts's Edge 401 emits the same closed set. This is a separate runtime and a separate producer: changing only the Node path leaves the Edge response disclosing, and leaves one reason carrying two different sentences.

One test per producer asserts the body's key set equals the expected set, not merely that detail is absent. The absent-field form would not catch free text reintroduced under another name, which is the guarantee D1 actually makes.

Server-side logging is unchanged: logError still records code, reason, message and stack, and message still resolves to internalMessage ?? detail. A test pins that an internalMessage carrying a record id still reaches the log while being absent from the body.
Tests asserting response detail are updated to assert reason instead. Assert the contract, not the wording.
